extDescription: Sign in with logins and codes from Nodkey on your iPhone. You approve every request with Face ID.
pairIntro: Nodkey keeps your logins and codes on your iPhone. Pair this browser once. Then you approve each request on your phone.
pairCodeHelp: In Nodkey on your iPhone, open Agents, tap Add agent and type this code:
pairCodeValid: The code is valid for $1 minutes.
pairCheckHelp: Your iPhone shows a check number. Is it the same as this one?
pairDifferentDone: The pairing was removed. Someone may have changed the keys on the way. Remove this browser under Agents in Nodkey, then pair again.
pairExpired: The code expired. Get a new code.
siteNone: Open a website to sign in with Nodkey.
siteInsecure: This page does not use HTTPS. Nodkey does not fill passwords here.
actWaitingHint: The request waits up to two minutes.
actNoField: Nodkey found no field to fill on this page.
actNoPassword: Your iPhone sent no password for $1.
actDenied: You denied the request on your iPhone.
actExpired: Your iPhone did not answer in time.
actPaused: Nodkey on your iPhone paused this browser. Turn it on again under Agents.
actOldProtocol: Update Nodkey on your iPhone and this extension. They use different versions.
actNotPaired: Your iPhone does not know this browser any more. Pair again.
actRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
actUnreachable: Nodkey cannot reach the relay. Check your connection and try again.
actPasskeySignedIn: Signed in to $1 with a passkey.
actPasskeyCreated: Saved a new passkey for $1 in Nodkey.
actPasskeyExists: Nodkey on your iPhone has a passkey for this account on $1 already.
actPasskeyNone: Nodkey on your iPhone has no passkey for $1.
actPasskeyCancelled: The page stopped the passkey request.
actNeedsPairing: Pair Nodkey with your iPhone first: click the Nodkey button in the toolbar.
saveAsk: Save the login for $1 in Nodkey?
saveAdded: Saved in Nodkey on your iPhone.
saveUpdated: The password is updated in Nodkey on your iPhone.
saveUnchanged: Nodkey on your iPhone has this login already.
saveDenied: Not saved. You said no on your iPhone.
saveKept: Your iPhone did not answer. The login waits, locked so that only your iPhone can read it. Send it again from the Nodkey button.
reasonPasskeyGet: Sign in to $1 with a passkey in $2
optNameHelp: The new name shows on your iPhone the next time you pair.
optNoPhone: Not paired yet. Click the Nodkey button in the toolbar to pair.
optUnpairHelp: This browser leaves your iPhone. Nodkey on the iPhone removes it the next time it checks for requests.
optScreenshots: Show a picture of the page in the notification
optScreenshotsHelp: The picture is encrypted so that only your iPhone can see it.
optPasskeysHelp: When a website asks for a passkey, Nodkey asks your iPhone. Turn this off to use the passkeys of the browser. Open pages change when you load them again.
optSiteAccessHelp: Nodkey needs access to websites to show its button in sign-in fields and to fill them.
optSiteAccessSafari: In Safari, click Nodkey in the toolbar and choose “Always Allow on Every Website”. Or open Safari Settings, Extensions, Nodkey, Edit Websites.
optSiteAccessOk: Nodkey can work on all websites.
optRelayHelp: The relay forwards encrypted messages between this browser and your iPhone. Change it only if you run your own relay.
